notes: Version 2.71 records GS-Note 2.6's clarified import of ENI 2.11 and Q6a. The note distinguishes the projection-preserving automorphism group in a category incorporating admissibility constraints from Q12's supplied physical structure group; the latter is not the group acting effectively within the automorphism group of ENI Definition 3. Non-trivial minimal gauge structure requires non-injectivity (ENI Proposition 4); for a non-injective projection such a structure exists exactly when the projection-preserving automorphism group is non-trivial (ENI Remark 4). Global phase rotations belong to that group on the supplied complex carrier insofar as the projection is defined through span-based observables (Q6a). Physical gauge structure remains supplied. The GS-Note entry, inventory row and graph node are aligned; dependency edges are unchanged.
